findings.title: Portfolio volatility exceeds conservative risk profile limits
findings.detail: The portfolio's volatility of {{m:risk.vol.pct}} exceeds the maximum threshold of {{m:risk.vol_band_max.pct}} for a conservative profile. Given the client's age of seventy-four and need for monthly income, this elevated volatility poses a significant risk to capital preservation.

findings.title: Significant downside risk identified in equity bear market scenario
findings.detail: In an equity bear market scenario, the portfolio is projected to lose {{m:stress.equity_bear.cad}}, representing a {{m:stress.equity_bear.pct}} decline. This potential loss is substantial for a retiree with moderate liquidity needs, as it could jeopardize the ability to sustain monthly income draws.

findings.title: Significant equity overweight relative to conservative profile
findings.detail: The portfolio is significantly overweight in equities, with Canadian equity {{m:alloc.CA_EQUITY.pct}} exceeding the target {{m:target.CA_EQUITY.pct}} and US equity {{m:alloc.US_EQUITY.pct}} exceeding the target {{m:target.US_EQUITY.pct}}. This drift exposes the conservative investor to higher volatility than intended.

Canadian bonds are currently {{m:alloc.CA_BONDS.pct}}, well below the target of {{m:target.CA_BONDS.pct}}. Given the client's reliance on RRIF withdrawals and stated nervousness regarding market dips, this underweight position in fixed income should be addressed to align with their capital preservation objective.
findings.title: Canadian bonds significantly underweight for conservative profile
No unused contribution room available for tax optimization
findings.detail: The client has no unused contribution room in either TFSA or RRSP accounts, as indicated by {{m:tax.tfsa_room.cad}} and {{m:tax.rrsp_room.cad}}. Consequently, there are no opportunities to optimize tax-advantaged space at this time.

findings.title: Canadian bond yields and policy rate impact on fixed income holdings
findings.detail: The Canada 10-year bond yield is currently {{m:mkt.ca_10y_yield.pct}} percent, reflecting the Bank of Canada's policy rate of {{m:mkt.ca_policy_rate.pct}} percent. This yield environment has influenced the valuation of Canadian fixed income holdings.

findings.title: US Treasury yields and currency fluctuations affecting equity valuations
findings.detail: The US 10-year Treasury yield of {{m:mkt.us_10y_yield.pct}} percent and the USD/CAD exchange rate of {{m:mkt.usd_cad.ratio}} have significantly impacted the valuation of US and international equity holdings in Canadian dollar terms.

findings.title: Canadian bond yields and policy rate impact on fixed income holdings
findings.detail: The Canada ten-year bond yield is currently {{m:mkt.ca_10y_yield.pct}} percent, reflecting the Bank of Canada's policy rate of {{m:mkt.ca_policy_rate.pct}} percent. This yield environment has influenced the valuation of Canadian fixed income holdings.

findings.title: US Treasury yields and currency fluctuations affecting equity valuations
findings.detail: The US ten-year Treasury yield of {{m:mkt.us_10y_yield.pct}} percent and the USD/CAD exchange rate of {{m:mkt.usd_cad.ratio}} have significantly impacted the valuation of US and international equity holdings in Canadian dollar terms.
